system.description:
A delicate and precise technique, the caster must carefully plan the arrangement of the shuriken, and carefully string them up with battle wire before swinging them precisely into a star-shaped pattern around them, warding off attacks and providing a deadly flourish of steel.

When this jutsu is cast, you may maneuver the storm of steel to strike a creature within the radius, making a ranged taijutsu attack, dealing [Weapons damage] + [Weapons damage] + 4d6 on a hit.

While concentrating on this jutsu, any hostile creature entering this radius for the first time on a turn or beginning or ending their turn within its radius must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Weapons damage] + [Weapons damage] + [Weapons damage] on a failure, or half as much on a success save.

Chain 3: For the duration, yourself and any allied creature of your choice within the radius of this jutsu, are considered to have Partial Cover against ranged attacks

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this above A-Rank, increase the cost by 3, and the attacks damage by 1d6
